name: DropUI – Popups, Lead Generation & Marketing Automation
author: dropui

sections.description:
Marketing automation for WordPress

DropUI is a marketing automation platform for WordPress that helps you generate leads, engage visitors while they browse, and bring them back after they leave. Create popups, bars, embedded forms, Feed, web push notifications, and WhatsApp campaigns from one dashboard.

Collect contacts and marketing opt-ins, show relevant messages to selected audiences, and continue the conversation beyond a single website visit. A free plan is available.

On any WordPress website, you can promote offers, content, events, and announcements and measure campaign results without editing your theme or site code.

A DropUI account is required to create, publish, and analyze campaigns.

Why DropUI?

Instead of installing and managing separate plugins for popups, forms, WhatsApp, web push notifications, recommendations, and automation, you can run them together in DropUI. One platform gives you a consistent way to build campaigns, target audiences, personalize messages, and measure results across multiple communication channels.

What can you do with DropUI?

  • Collect contacts and marketing opt-ins with popups and embedded forms.
  • Promote offers, content, events, and important announcements on any WordPress website.
  • Show targeted popups, bars, and embedded content based on the page, traffic source, device, visitor behavior, and exit intent.
  • Bring visitors back after their session with web push notifications or WhatsApp.
  • Personalize communication for new and returning visitors.
  • Measure impressions, clicks, conversions, and A/B test results.

Running WooCommerce?

DropUI uses WooCommerce store and cart data to power more relevant e-commerce campaigns. Target shoppers by product, category, variation, coupon, cart contents, cart value, free-shipping threshold, or checkout stage.

Use this context to recover abandoned carts, recommend products, create upsell campaigns, help increase average order value, and encourage shoppers to complete checkout.

Communication channels

  • Popup – show offers, forms, and messages based on the page and visitor behavior.
  • Bar – highlight promotions, announcements, limited-time offers, and free-shipping thresholds.
  • Embed – place forms, recommendations, and offers in selected areas of your website.
  • Feed – add an onsite panel where visitors can return to current offers, updates, and recommendations while browsing.
  • Web push – remind visitors about new content, offers, events, and unfinished actions after they leave.
  • WhatsApp – send offers and reminders, then continue the conversation when a customer replies.

Display rules and personalization

In DropUI Builder, you can decide who sees a campaign, where it appears, when it is triggered, and how often a visitor sees it.

Campaigns can respond to:

  • the current page or WordPress content type,
  • a visitor’s first or repeat visit,
  • onsite behavior, including exit intent,
  • device, language, traffic source, and UTM parameters,
  • user login status,
  • schedules, display delays, and frequency limits.

If you use WooCommerce, campaigns can also take into account the product, category, tag, variation, coupon, cart contents, cart value, free-shipping threshold, and checkout stage.

Creating campaigns

You can build a campaign from scratch, use a prebuilt e-commerce scenario, or describe your goal to the AI Assistant. Scenarios are especially useful for WooCommerce stores, and the Assistant can suggest copy, layout, and calls to action.

On the Start plan and above, an onboarding specialist helps you configure DropUI, publish your first campaigns, and review results.

How to get started

  1. Install and activate the DropUI plugin.
  2. Connect your WordPress website to your DropUI account.
  3. Choose an e-commerce scenario, use the AI Assistant, or create your own campaign.
  4. Set the audience and display rules.
  5. Publish the campaign and analyze the results.

New customers receive 70% off the first three months of any monthly plan. On the Start plan and above, an onboarding specialist helps you set up DropUI and optimize your scenarios.

View plans and pricing

The offer is available once to new customers. Standard pricing for the selected plan applies from the fourth month.

Explore DropUI features

Compatibility

The plugin requires WordPress 6.3 or newer and PHP 7.4 or newer.

The plugin has been tested up to WordPress 7.0.

In a WordPress Multisite network, each site connects to DropUI independently and has its own configuration and campaigns.

External Service

This plugin connects your WordPress website to DropUI, an external online service. A DropUI account is required to create, publish, and analyze campaigns.

Service provider:
E-TRADE SOLUTIONS Sp. z o.o.

When the administrator starts the connection process, the plugin sends information required to identify and connect the WordPress website, including:

  • a unique site identifier,
  • the WordPress site name,
  • the site URL,
  • the connection callback URL,
  • the WordPress administrator email address,
  • the platform identifier,
  • information about whether the site already has an authentication secret.

For authenticated actions such as signing in to DropUI or disconnecting the site, the plugin sends a signed request containing the site identifier, requested action, timestamp, nonce value, and cryptographic signature.

After the site is connected, the service may process information needed to select, display, and measure campaigns, including:

  • the URL of the visited page,
  • campaign identifiers,
  • impressions, clicks, and conversions,
  • device, language, and traffic-source information,
  • user behavior related to a campaign,
  • information voluntarily submitted through forms, such as an email address or phone number.

If the website uses WooCommerce, the processed context may also include product, category, variation, coupon, cart contents, cart value, and checkout stage.

The exact scope of processed information depends on the website configuration, enabled features, and active campaigns.

The plugin does not connect the site to DropUI until the administrator explicitly starts the connection process.

sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins -> Add New.
  2. Search for DropUI.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Open DropUI in your WordPress dashboard.
  5. Sign in or create a DropUI account.
  6. Confirm the site connection.
  7. Choose an e-commerce scenario, campaign template, or create your first campaign.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

No. DropUI also works on WordPress websites without WooCommerce. WooCommerce is only needed for features that use store data such as products, coupons, cart contents, order value, or checkout stage.

Do I need a DropUI account?

Yes. The plugin connects your WordPress website to the DropUI service, where you create, publish, and analyze campaigns.

Can I match campaigns to my website design?

Yes. You can customize content, colors, layout, images, calls to action, and display rules to match your brand and WordPress theme.

Can I target campaigns to different visitors?

Yes. Campaigns can respond to the page, device, language, traffic source, UTM parameters, login status, and visitor behavior. If you use WooCommerce, they can also use product, coupon, cart, and checkout information.

Does DropUI support WordPress Multisite?

Yes. Each site in a Multisite network connects to DropUI separately and has its own campaigns.

Where can I get support?

General questions about installation, activation, compatibility, and common plugin issues can be posted on the WordPress.org support forum.

For account, payment, specific site, campaign configuration, private data, or backend diagnostics questions, contact DropUI support:

support@dropui.com
